all.definition: POPULATION: all frozen scenarios in the regime. ANSWERS: 'how often does each scheme finish at all, how many tasks does it retire, and does it stay collision-free?' If stop-and-wait fails where the proposed system completes, that is a RELIABILITY result and is reported as such. It is NOT a speedup of any percentage, and in particular a failure is never scored as an infinite or 500% improvement.
